algorithm_change: The continuation portfolio now canonicalizes completed outer-corona exterior occupancy under the root stabilizer and memoizes obstructed boundary states across solutions and seeds. Exact placement clauses are still learned whenever an obstruction explanation is available.
conclusion: Whole-corona boundary states are much more discriminating than the six individual contact types: 1922 of 2522 distinct sampled radius-one states are exact radius-two obstructions. The surviving states and sampled censuses leave the tiling classification unresolved.
